requirements.text: Experience in IT Operations, Systems Administration, or a similar role with hands-on scripting/automation responsibility.
Practical experience administering at least two of: Microsoft 365 (Entra ID/Exchange/SharePoint admin), Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune.
Working proficiency in at least one scripting/automation language (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Google Apps Script).
Understanding of core identity and device management concepts: SSO, MDM/UEM, conditional access, device compliance.
Ability to document processes clearly for a small team that needs to maintain what you build.
Experience with Slack administration or Slack API/workflow automation.
Experience with a scripting/orchestration platform (e.g., Workato, Tines, Zapier, Azure Automation, or similar iPaaS tools).
Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft MS-102/MD-102, Jamf Certified Admin, Google Workspace Administrator).
Familiarity with security/compliance frameworks relevant to endpoint and identity management (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).
Experience working on a small IT team where you own end-to-end delivery rather than a narrow slice of a larger org.

resumes.text:
Lena Hartwig
IT Systems Engineer | Hamburg, Germany

Summary
IT systems engineer with seven years of experience running and automating corporate IT for mid-sized companies. I focus on identity, device management and scripting, and I like building workflows that other people can maintain.

Experience
Senior IT Systems Engineer, Brightwater Logistics GmbH, Hamburg (2021 - present)
- Administer Microsoft 365, including Entra ID, Exchange Online and SharePoint, for 900 users.
- Manage JAMF for the macOS fleet and Microsoft Intune for Windows and mobile devices, including configuration profiles and compliance policies.
- Wrote PowerShell and Python scripts that automate onboarding and offboarding across Entra ID and Intune, cutting provisioning time from two days to under an hour.
- Built integrations that pull data from vendor web endpoints using authenticated JSON requests, linking the HR system to group membership changes.
- Designed conditional access rules with the security team so that devices must be compliant before they reach mail and file storage.
- Administer Microsoft Teams policies and meeting settings for the company.
- Wrote runbooks for every automated workflow so the service desk can recover failed jobs without engineering help.
- Contributed control evidence for ISO 27001 during the annual audit, collecting access review records from identity systems.
- Led the rollout of a company-wide AI assistant, writing usage guidelines and license rules together with legal.

IT Support Specialist, Nordlicht Media AG, Berlin (2018 - 2021)
- Handled device imaging and patching for 300 Windows and macOS endpoints.
- Maintained Active Directory accounts and group policies.
- Worked in a team of four that supported the whole office, owning projects from planning to delivery.

Education
B.Sc. Business Informatics, Kiel University (2018)
Microsoft MD-102 Endpoint Administrator certification (2023)

Skills
PowerShell, Python, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, JAMF Pro, Active Directory, SSO, MDM, Git, technical documentation, German native, English C1.
